title: 각종분쟁조정위원회등의조정조서등에대한집행문부여에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Commissioning Delivery of Copies of Records, etc.)
(1) Where a chief court clerk, senior court clerk or junior court clerk of the competent district court (hereinafter referred to as a "court clerk, etc.") receives an application for granting a writ of execution, that official shall commission the mediation committee that prepared the record to which the application relates to send a copy of the record, using attached Form 1.
(2) A mediation committee receiving a commission to send a copy under paragraph (1) shall send the copy of the record to the competent district court's court clerk, etc. without delay.
